traffic.note: OSM classes, same-level main-road proximity and explicit maxspeed=30. Cartographic zone membership alone never changes a road classification. No live or historical vehicle counts.

trafficZones.note: Cartographic source is not survey-accurate. Lines require both an implemented municipal zone and explicit OSM maxspeed=30; incomplete coverage, not authoritative speed limits.

addresses.note: Partial coverage. Node coordinates or derived building-label positions, not verified entrances. The municipal public CSV has no coordinates and is not used for geocoding.

walking.note: Original OSM topology; no offset sidewalks or invented crossings. Separately mapped sidewalks and crossings are retained, but street centrelines remain. No general side-of-street precision.

detailedShade.note: Actual LoD2 roof/facade surfaces with DGM1 receiver elevations, averaged to 2 m; UTM32/DHHN2016. Experimental, no tree or terrain-cast shade.
